# Velvet Dinosaur

Velvet Dinosaur is a founder-led web studio building bespoke websites, web apps, and mobile apps with a focus on performance, accessibility, maintainability, and conversion.

## Key Pages

- [Homepage](https://velvetdinosaur.com/)
- [Selected work](https://velvetdinosaur.com/work)
- [Contact](https://velvetdinosaur.com/#contact)
- [Sitemap](https://velvetdinosaur.com/sitemap.xml)
- [Robots](https://velvetdinosaur.com/robots.txt)

## Crawling Guidance

Public marketing and case-study pages may be crawled for search and discovery. Administrative, preview, edit, and demo routes should not be crawled or indexed.
